periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation converging downward toward the medial axis of the rostrum at approximately 45-60 degrees.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical-axis elongated oval with a teardrop tapering toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visual downward elongation resulting in a shift of the centroid toward the inferior-medial margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped curvature along the posterior boundary of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness occupying approximately 30-40% of the visible dorsal torso area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the cranial vault, approximately double the width of an individual pinna base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Regularly curved semicircular arcs without visible flattening or notches.
